title: pip-audit waiver schema (WP-18)
description: Time-bounded waivers for high/critical findings. Absent a valid unexpired waiver, audits fail closed on main/release/tags.
notes: Do not waive without owner + expiry.
Empty waivers/ directory means zero active waivers.

example.rationale: No reachability in VerifierLab base install; tracked upstream.
